object: actual path cost of compact B3M selector
question: How many tree comparisons does the fixed D435 compact selector actually visit on fresh rows?
number: Across 60 fresh D432/D433 replays, the 32-tree depth-4 D435 selector visited 115..128 non-root nodes (mean 124.6666666667, total 7480) plus 32 accumulators per candidate; 256 feature bits remain separate. This is an exact structural path audit only and gives no score credit.
